intro: Create a Stream Launch countdown in six short sections. The timer changes only when you run one of its approved Streamer.bot controls.

sections.title: 1. Countdown
sections.description: Choose the normal duration. At least one second is required.

sections.title: 2. Completion
sections.description: Show a custom message and optionally play one core-generated tone when the timer reaches zero.

sections.title: 3. Optional scene switch
sections.description: At zero, run one triggerless Streamer.bot action that you approve below. That action can switch OBS, Streamlabs Desktop, Meld, or perform another creator-owned transition.
sections.notice: Enable this only after adding exactly one safe target under Approved Streamer.bot actions. Complete Now is preview-only and never runs the target action.

sections.title: 4. Overlay layout
sections.description: Choose the label, font, background behavior, progress bar, and urgency thresholds.

sections.title: 5. Overlay colors
sections.description: Customize the background, accent, text, warning, critical, running, and border colors.

sections.title: 6. Scene setup
sections.description: Import the separate Streamer.bot package, attach Start to your Starting Soon scene-active trigger, and attach Stop when leaving that scene.
sections.notice: Start always begins a fresh configured countdown. Stop pauses and hides it. Set & Start uses its editable countdownSeconds argument for a one-off duration. Complete Now previews the completion message and tone without switching scenes. The add-on never reacts to follows, gifts, subscriptions, chat, or rewards.
